generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor, at least one similar work of Supply OR Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Evaporative Cooling Pads for air washer system or Supply OR Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Air Handling connected Equipments and accessories in any Thermal power station / Major industries / Utilities of worth Rs. 5.50 Lakh (Inclusive of GST) in single work order during last 5 years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of this the agency shall upload One Purchase Order Copy OR Work done certificate of similar work carried out of value not less than Rs. 5.50 Lakh (Inclusive of GST), issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer for KPCL and Executive Engineer and above or equivalent in case of other organizations.(Work done of previous year shall be given weightage at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year).Similar Work means: Supply OR Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Evaporative Cooling Pads for air washer system or Supply OR Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Air Handling connected Equipments and accessories.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- the agency shall upload One Work Order Copy and corresponding Work done certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should be OEM in Evaporative Cooling Pads for air washer system OR Air Handling connected Equipments. As a proof the bidder should upload valid Registration certificate issued by the Competent Authority. OR Bidder should be OES in Evaporative Cooling Pads for air washer system OR Air Handling connected equipments. As a proof the bidder should upload valid Authorization/dealership letter from OEM. OR Bidder should be a Service Provider/Agency having carried out Supply OR Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Evaporative Cooling Pads for air washer system OR Supply OR Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Air Handling connected Equipments. As proof of this the bidder should upload a Purchase order copy OR Work order copy of similar work carried out in Supply OR Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Evaporative Cooling Pads for air washer system or Supply OR Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Air Handling connected Equipments and accessories.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- upload valid Registration certificate issued /Authorization/dealership letter from OEM/PO or work order copy of similar work carried out

technicalCriterionList.description: Bidder in its name should have in the last five years achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 11.00 lakhs(Inclusive of GST). As a proof, the tenderer shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant. Turnover of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited.
